data.off_schedule: Off-hours schedule (a schedule helper: its blocks are the off hours)

lights.title: Light settings
lights.description: Dimmer: at 1 % zone level the light gets 'min', at 100 % it gets 'scale' (straight line in between; 0 % is off). On/off: on when the zone level reaches 'threshold'.

light_types.title: Light types
light_types.description: Dimmer: brightness follows the zone level. On/off: on above a threshold. Switches are always on/off.

error.light_in_other_zone: One of these lights already belongs to another zone.
error.schedule_required: Choose a schedule helper for the off hours, or set off hours to none.

options.daylight: Follows daylight (evening ramp, optional boost, cosy, morning ramp)
options.fixed: Fixed level whenever the zone is on

options.window: Fade out at the start of each block, back on at its end
options.switch_off: Fade out at the start of a block and switch the zone off

auto_on.name: Turn on
auto_on.description: Switch auto on: follow the sun and manage the lights.

auto_off.name: Turn off
auto_off.description: Switch auto off: lights off, and the zone leaves them alone until auto is switched on, or comes back on by the zone's 'Auto back on' setting.

override_on.name: Set override
override_on.description: Lights at a set level, also when auto is off; for example for visitors.

level.name: Level
level.description: Level for this override only; leave empty to use the zone's override level.

until.name: Until
until.description: next_phase, the next solar noon, or after a duration.

override_toggle.name: Toggle override
override_toggle.description: Switch the override on (at the zone's override level, until the next solar noon) or off.
